# HakoDB — llms.txt

> HakoDB: embedded document database (Rust) with vector + graph search and multi-plane sync. These notes map the site root and the manual at https://hakodb.github.io/docs/ for AI assistants. Code identifiers are exact; verify signatures against hakodb source or docs.rs before generating calls.

- Site: product overview, features, sync modes, SDK install table, quickstart, and the manual index.
  https://hakodb.github.io/ https://hakodb.github.io/docs/
- Start here: intro, concepts (collections, typed values, in-process model), choosing a mode (embedded vs net/cloud/socket sync).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/intro.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/concepts.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/choosing-mode.html
- Core: CRUD (put/get/patch/delete/subdocuments), queries (filters, order, cursors, aggregates, planner), pipelines (match/project/sort/limit/offset/unwind/group, no joins), indexes (secondary/composite/FTS, background readiness), reading paths (decoded/raw/walk/view, keyset paging, blob semantics).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/crud.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/queries.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/pipelines.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/indexes.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/reads.html
- Vector KNN: create_vector_index + find_near, LE-f32 fields, cosine/L2, index-before-write, one-model rule, graphs rebuild locally.
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/vector.html
- Graph: Reference edges, create_traverse_index + find_paths (BFS, depth 1..=32), create_edge_index + via_edge/weight_field Dijkstra, untracked-incoming errors loudly.
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/graph.html
- Writes: write_batch (atomic), serializable transactions (conflict retry), watch_collection streams, durability modes, encryption, compression, backup/recovery.
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/transactions.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/watch.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/durability.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backup-recovery.html
- Errors: HakoError variants (Io, LockPoisoned, StorageError, QueryError, IndexError, Corrupt, InvalidInput); fail-closed rules (loud over empty, no silent clamping).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/errors.html
- Sync: rooms, versions/deltas, LWW, echo suppression, withheld/excluded/local-only, same-minor lockstep; mesh guide (mDNS, rooms, troubleshooting), cloud guide (server/client, VersionPing, auth), cloud hub scaling (one writer pod + read-only mesh replicas, manual failover), LAN relay (one cloud client per LAN, admission cap, lag meter), socket plane (unix, balancer), encryption posture (wire vs at-rest, caps rule, operating).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-concepts.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-mesh.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-cloud.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/scaling.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/lan-relay.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-socket.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-encryption.html
- Cluster: dispatcher (reads fan out, writes route, promote/epoch, health), multidb named clusters (exact-name, per-db mesh dirs, FFI), Hako-only members, N+1 sync tailer (mesh/cloud, client/server) for multi-box.
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/cluster.html
- SDKs: C ABI (179 fns, handles, ownership, status codes), JS/TS (@hakodb/client: open, collection/doc, where/orderBy, onSnapshot, native sync script), Go (cgo, explicit Free, sync-core), Pascal (THako/THKDocument, try/finally, Lazarus packages), Tauri (gateway registration + @hakodb/tauri modular API), CLI (full command/config/serve reference), HTTP backend (hakobackend wire), backend TS client (@hakodb/backend CRUD, realtime, React hooks).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-c-abi.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-js.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-go.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-pascal.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-tauri.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-cli.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-backend.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-backend-ts.html
- Shipping: real-product recipes (Tauri offline-first, CLI tool, hakobackend web/mobile, LAN mesh, multi-instance cluster, analytics), operations (sizing, scaling, upgrades, backups, FAQ), benchmarking (hakobench build/run, metrics, settling, fair comparison, gate), MCP server (hakomcp stdio tools/resources), balancer (hakobalancer: under evaluation, lower RPS than direct hakobackend).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/recipes.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/operations.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/benchmarking.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/mcp.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/balancer.html
- Backend: gateway+drivers+policy+auth architecture, quickstart (static binary, path rule), TOML config (drivers, multidb, reload-vs-restart), aliases, indexes (kinds, coverage rule, vector/graph/archive), policy (default-deny, resolution, claim caveat), auth (chain, local BFF, DPoP, service keys), drivers (registry, conformance, writing one), realtime WS/SSE, files, TTL/unique/coalescing, deploy (systemd, backups, monitoring).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-overview.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-quickstart.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-config.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-alias.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-indexes.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-policy.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-auth.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-drivers.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-realtime-files.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-deploy.html
- Cloud server (hakocloudserver): N rooms per process, one direct Hako db + one single-room sync listener per room, [[rooms]] file config, login-bound sessions (no default room), console (data/users/groups/events/maintenance), deploy (ports, TLS, services, posture).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/cloudserver-overview.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/cloudserver-config.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/cloudserver-console.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/cloudserver-deploy.html
- Agent engine (hakoagent): agent memory/skills/code-graph over HakoDB, `python install.py` (downloads native lib per platform), CLI verbs (init/index/recall/impact/cache/graph/task/skill/events/vigilance), MCP server per project (off by default), token economy (recall-first, TTL cache, graph queries).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/hakoagent.html
- Source of truth for API: Rust engine `Hako` (97 pub fns), C ABI `hakodb.h` (179 fns), the contract/spec files kept in each repository, and the pages indexed above.
